title: Negative: Codex role-process mode attempts to use plugin-provided MCP server
description: Verifies Codex adapter rejects or excludes plugin-provided MCP servers that have no [mcp_servers.<name>] table.

preconditions.repoState: Codex config with plugin-provided MCP server only
constraints: child role processes run with --disable plugins

stimulus.userPrompt: Select plugin-provided MCP server for External.
events: Codex adapter validates server selection against config.toml

assertions: Plugin-provided MCP server is rejected for External role-process selection

provenance.sourceSummary: Held-out negative validation scenario for Codex plugin MCP isolation (#209).
